text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: `GPU_MEMORY_PRESSURE` on pool `dedicated-nyc-a` (severity: critical). Alert ID INC-2026-1459. Metrics: gpu_mem_util=98%, kv_cache_evictions=12k/min.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty -> page fired to schedule: eng-oncall. Assigned to: maria.
maria: acked :wave: I’m on it. grabbing metrics now. PD INC-2026-1459
raj: seeing a huge spike in kv cache evictions and slab alloc failures on cuda node group `nyc-a-3`. logs show repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` in model-serving process.
sean: rolling logs for model-serving: ```ERROR: cudart: out of memory at allocate 0x7f... size=1.2G
stack: serve_v2->kv_prefetch->alloc``` Looks like a prefetch storm.
lina-cs: any customer impact? Support ticket #CUST-998 shows elevated 503s for tenant `acrosoft` starting ~5m ago.
maria: confirmed, several requests failing with 502/503. Marking customer-impact: partial degraded for a subset of models. Notifying CS.
ops-runner-bot: Suggested playbook: 1) isolate noisy pool, 2) throttle kv-prefetch, 3) evict stale kvcache, 4) reroute traffic to `dedicated-nyc-b` fallback. Run commands below.
raj: attempting to throttle prefetch via runtime flag change. Pushing config: `service.api.runtime.kv_prefetch.max_inflight=8` to canary 10% first.
maria: good. also increase eviction aggressiveness: `kvcache.eviction.threshold=0.6` on the affected hosts. Applying now.
sean: running immediate one-off to free memory on node nyc-a-3: ```ssh root@nyc-a-3 sudo systemctl kill --signal=SIGUSR1 model-serve && sudo /usr/local/bin/redis-kv-evict --target=30%```
raj: telemetry shows evictions spike then memory usage drops 20% on that node. cuda OOM errors reduced.
lina-cs: CS update sent: "We are mitigating an edge-case prefetch storm causing partial request failures for some customers. No data loss. We'll update in 30m or earlier."
maria: rerouting traffic now: updating smart-routing policy to move 40% of load to `dedicated-nyc-b` and 100% for high-priority customers.
ops-runner-bot: Route update command: ```POST /routing/v1/policies/_update {"rule":"fallback:dedicated-nyc-b","percent":40}```
sean: after reroute, error rate for `acrosoft` dropped from 8% -> 1.2%. latency stable.
raj: leaving increased tracing on for 15m to ensure no regression. collecting heap dumps from model worker for later analysis.
maria: planning a postmortem if we don't find immediate root cause — tagging SRE and ML infra. For now keeping PD incident open until all nodes normalized.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-1459 acknowledged by maria at T+1m. Escalation set to L2 if unack > 6m.
incident-bot: Note: suggested long-term mitigations: limit aggressive prefetch defaults, add per-tenant prefetch quotas, and KV cache memory caps.
lina-cs: Customers notified. No urgent escalations from executive side.
maria: will hand off at next shift to raj in 30m if stable. leaving a runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-memory-pressure
raj: copying logs and heap dumps to /mnt/incident/INC-2026-1459 for forensics.
sean: leaving connection checks enabled, will watch for new CUDA errors.
maria: thanks team. keeping thread open until all nodes show mem_util < 75% and no OOMs for 20m.
ops-runner-bot: Monitoring rule: auto-close if no OOM events for 20m across pool `dedicated-nyc-a`.
maria: update @lina-cs we'll send a formal RCA if we confirm a prefetch regression. closing chatter unless anything new shows up. :thumbsup:
